item.title: In the Deep End With Jordan Wax
item.description: The last night of Chanukah this year fell on the solstice — the start of winter and the longest night of the year. Although known as "the festival of lights," Chanukah felt dark in the wake of yet another antisemitic-motivated hate crime on Bondi Beach in Melbourne, Australia.
